mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that directly support corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it indicates a tightening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings acceleration and positive equity returns, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher real discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls simultaneously in more than 55% of cases without negative 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0% and is rising, the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces market liquidity and increases risk premiums, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% and is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and residential investment that directly boosts corporate revenue streams, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 350,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 350,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency that directly supports corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based economic expansion that strengthens corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return prediction fails when HOUST and INDPRO both increase simultaneously in more than 55% of cases without positive 5-day returns.
